definitions.explanation: Resetting a device or storage medium to its original state; erasing all data and restoring default settings.

examples.japanese: ハードディスクを{初期化|しょきか}する。
{初期化|しょきか}するとデータが{消|き}えます。
examples.english: Data will be erased if you initialize.

examples.japanese: スマホを{売|う}る{前|まえ}に{初期化|しょきか}した{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: You should factory reset your smartphone before selling it.

notes:
{初期化|しょきか} means to reset to initial/factory state, commonly used for electronic devices and storage media.

WORD COMPOSITION:
- {初期|しょき}: initial, early stage
- {化|か}: -ization, making into

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初期化|しょきか}する: to initialize, to format
- {初期化|しょきか}{画面|がめん}: initialization screen
- {工場|こうじょう}{初期化|しょきか}: factory reset
- {初期化|しょきか}に{失敗|しっぱい}: initialization failed

WARNING:
- {初期化|しょきか} deletes all data - always back up before initializing
- Used for troubleshooting or preparing devices for sale/transfer
